result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Canada, my top recommendation is **QuickBooks Online**\. It's a strong all-around choice for tracking income and expenses, managing GST/HST, invoicing customers, and preparing financial reports.

However, depending on the size and type of your business, there may be a better and less expensive option.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online**

(Best overall)

- Great for most small businesses.
- Tracks income, expenses, GST/PST and HST.
- Bank account integration.
- Payroll options and financial reports.
- Many Canadian accountants use it.

Best for: Established small businesses and growing companies.

[QuickBooks Canada](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/)

---

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for multiple users)

- Easy-to-use interface.
- Excellent bank reconciliation.
- Unlimited users on its plans.
- Strong accounting and reporting features.

Best for: Businesses with employees, bookkeepers or multiple partners.

[Xero Canada](https://www.xero.com/ca/)

---

![Free Wave Financial Inc. Logo Vector Download | Logowik](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tnsMywbhmGAbFqPGr6O6DRlr31UIPIOPlNOMdf6um-89wvuooxUnVR2zBx_BWRY62sU-oEIrmhWudT2Iq__WN2d_uJSl7RY3WikgQVspfhcPs3tKMFKFs5Xx7GT_25_4ERvIXrsRVuZT0eEu7vba7OwhSfn0VtBIomBp5nrMl6pAjSavjUdtqHSynMOahhsM?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Wave Accounting**

(Best budget option)

- Free basic accounting plan.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Simple to learn.
- Paid plan adds automatic bank transaction imports.

Best for: Sole proprietors and very small businesses.

[Wave website](https://www.waveapps.com/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreshBooks**

- Very user-friendly.
- Excellent invoicing.
- Tracks billable hours and expenses.
- Good for service-based businesses.

Best for: Contractors, consultants and freelancers.

[FreshBooks Canada](https://www.freshbooks.com/en-ca)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good accounting features for the price.
- Invoicing and expense management.
- Automated workflows.
- Free option for eligible smaller businesses.

Best for: Businesses wanting affordable accounting with automation.

[Zoho Books Canada](https://www.zoho.com/ca/books/)
